newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: CRICKET-DEBUTANT MOHAMMAD ZAHID STRIKES TWICE IN OPENING SESSION.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-DEBUTANT MOHAMMAD ZAHID STRIKES TWICE IN OPENING SESSION.

text.p: Debutant Mohammad Zahid struck twice in the space of seven deliveries on Thursday as Pakistan took the honours on the opening morning of the second test against New Zealand.
The touring team were 68 for three at lunch, play having started 20 minutes late because new balls had not arrived on time.
Zahid, a right-arm fast medium bowler, trapped opener Justin Vaughan and Adam Parore leg before for 12 and three respectively.
Spinner Mushtaq Ahmed also won an lbw decision against Bryan Young after the opener had struck five boundaries in his 39.
